# Morph v1.3.0-dev / XY Machine Manager

Complete development installer: latest A/B presets, bounded BYPASS S tracking,
machine additions/removals, alphabetical lists and installed-machine filtering.
MultiFX SDK support is already integrated; LINEAR is excluded.

Read [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md) for updating an existing installation,
[AB-PRESETS.md](AB-PRESETS.md) for preset controls and limits, and
[SDK_ADDITIONS.md](SDK_ADDITIONS.md) for future SDK additions.

This combined edition awaits native build, Mac GUI and hardware acceptance.
The previous MultiFX build worked on the owner's device; that result does not
validate this revision. No firmware, private kit or compiler is distributed.
